g.aria-label: Information Sandwich: d_Rp(p, q) = 2 JS(p, q) − I(a₁; a₂)
q → p: d_Rp(p, q) ≈ 2 JS(p, q) (Ratio → 2)
Marginal JS = Θ(‖p−q‖²) while redundancy I(a₁; a₂) = Θ(‖p−q‖⁴)
Sandwich: JS(p, q) ≤ d_Rp(p, q) ≤ min(2 JS(p, q), log 2)
Second pair member adds I(a₂; y | a₁) = JS(p, q) − I(a₁; a₂) ≥ 0
p ⊥ q: d_Rp(p, q) = JS(p, q) = log 2 (Ratio → 1)
First sample a₁ determines y (I(a₁; a₂) = log 2); still saturates!
Chain rule of mutual information explains both the 2× local gain and log 2 ceiling
